tools.name: find_latest_filings
tools.description: Use this when the user wants the latest SEC filings or EDGAR search results for a US public company, for example the latest 10-Q, 8-K filings, or a 10-K. Reads live SEC EDGAR submissions data and returns each filing's form, filing date, report date, description and a link to the document on sec.gov.
